partial.same_order_help:
The remaining COD amount is automatically added to the same order shortly after it is placed (typically within 1–2 minutes). Ideal for stores that fulfill orders manually.

Example: If the order total is ₹1000 and the customer pays ₹100 upfront, the same order will be updated to reflect ₹900 as the COD amount.
partial.new_order_help:
The original order is automatically cancelled, and a new order is created for the remaining COD amount. Best suited for stores with automatic fulfillment workflows.

Example: If the order total is ₹1000 and the customer pays ₹100 upfront, the original order is cancelled and a new order for ₹900 (COD) is generated.

setup.cod_only_through_form_help: Hides Cash on delivery at Shopify checkout so COD orders always come through the form. This is saved now and takes effect at checkout with the next COD King checkout update.
setup.code_field_enabled: Let buyers enter a Shopify discount code
setup.code_field_help: The Discount block must also be on in Form designer.
setup.codes_combine_help: Off: a code replaces quantity-offer and downsell discounts when it is better for the buyer.
setup.countries_all: No country selected: the form is available in every country.
setup.countries_help: The COD button is shown to buyers in these countries. Buyers elsewhere get your normal checkout.
setup.discount_label_enabled: Show the prepaid discount next to the renamed Buy now button
setup.discount_label_help: Uses the value from Prepaid discount.
setup.embed_off_body: Turn on the "COD Form" app embed in the theme editor, save the theme, then come back and check again. The editor opens in a new tab.
setup.embed_on_body: The "COD Form" app embed is on. It adds the COD button and loads the form only when a buyer asks for it.
setup.embed_unknown_body: Your theme could not be read just now. Check again in a moment.
setup.embedded_enabled: Show the form inline on the product page instead of a popup
setup.embedded_selector: CSS selector to place the form (optional)
setup.embedded_title: Embedded form on the product page
setup.health_cap_flagged: You have passed your plan's form orders for this month. Your form keeps working.
setup.health_cap_reached: You have reached this month's form order limit. The Buy with COD button is off on your store until next month, or until you upgrade.
setup.health_embed_off: The COD Form app embed is off, so the COD button is not shown on your storefront.
setup.health_legacy_embed_on: Express checkout is also on, and both can run together. While "COD King OTP Block" is on, your theme's Buy now and Checkout buttons open Express checkout, and the Buy with COD button opens the COD Form. Turn that embed off only if you want those buttons to go to Shopify checkout.
setup.health_no_country: No country is enabled for the COD Form.
setup.health_no_shipping_rate: No shipping rate is active. Buyers cannot complete the form until a rate matches their address.
setup.health_otp_unavailable: OTP could not be sent for %{count} orders in the last 24 hours. Those orders were placed without verification. Check your message balance.
setup.health_rule_cod_fee_ignored: Your partial payment rules include a COD fee. The COD Form uses the fee from COD fees settings, which is currently off.
setup.health_zip_allow_list_no_exact: This list has no exact postal codes, so Shopify checkout will hide COD for every buyer. Add exact codes, or turn on "COD only through the form".
setup.hide_oos: Hide the COD button for out-of-stock variants
setup.legacy_embed_body: Both can run together. While "COD King OTP Block" is on, your theme's Buy now and Checkout buttons open Express checkout, and the Buy with COD button opens the COD Form. Turn that embed off only if you want those buttons to go to Shopify checkout.
setup.mode_confirm_body: COD Form adds a Buy with COD button to your storefront. All your Express checkout settings are kept and nothing else changes.
setup.mode_confirm_point_embed: The button appears once the COD Form app embed is on in your theme.
setup.mode_confirm_point_fallback: If the form cannot open, the button takes the buyer to Shopify checkout.
setup.mode_confirm_point_off: You can turn it off here at any time.
setup.mode_error: The mode could not be changed. Try again.
setup.mode_off_body: Your store currently uses %{legacy}. Turn on COD Form to add a Buy with COD button that opens a one-page order form.
setup.mode_off_confirm_body: The Buy with COD button is removed from your storefront and your store goes back to %{legacy}. Your form, buttons, rates and offers are kept.
setup.mode_on_body: Buyers who tap the COD button order in the COD Form without leaving the page.
setup.mode_save_first: Save or discard your changes before switching.
setup.mode_embed_first: Turn on the COD Form app embed in your theme first (the card above), then click Check again.
setup.order_total_help: Offer the COD Form only when the order total is in this range. Leave a field empty for no limit.
setup.order_total_invalid: The maximum must be higher than the minimum.
setup.order_total_message: Message when the total is out of range (optional)
setup.pages_quick_buy: Quick buy on home and collection pages
setup.respect_privacy: Respect the buyer's cookie consent for tracking
setup.respect_privacy_help: Marketing pixels and funnel analytics follow Shopify's Customer Privacy settings.
setup.rules_note: Products that fail a Limit COD rule never get the COD button. Those rules are set once, in Limit COD.
setup.show_pay_online: Show "Pay online instead" in the form
setup.subtitle: Turn the form on, choose where it shows and check that everything is ready.
setup.test_order_error: The test link could not be created. Try again.
setup.test_order_help: Check the whole flow on your storefront before buyers see it. The test link works even while COD Form is off.
setup.test_order_note: Creating a new link turns the previous one off.
setup.test_step_1: Open the test link. It opens your storefront in a new tab.
setup.test_step_2: Go to a product, tap Buy with COD and complete the form.
setup.test_step_3: The order appears in Shopify with the tag codking_form_test. It sends messages like a real order, but does not count toward your order limit, fraud limits or analytics.
setup.test_step_4: Cancel the test order in Shopify when you are done.

setup.address_autocomplete_help: Suggest full addresses while the buyer types, so fewer orders come back with a wrong address.
setup.autocomplete_ola_key_help: Use your own Ola Maps key with the Places APIs enabled, restricted to your store domain. Ola bills you for its use.

shipping.cond_provinces_help: Country code, a dash, then the province code, for example HU-BU. Separate entries with commas.
shipping.conditions_help: The rate is offered only when every condition you fill in is met. Leave a condition empty to ignore it.
shipping.currency_help: Leave empty for your store currency. A rate applies only to orders in its currency.
shipping.delete_body: "%{name}" will no longer be offered in the form.

shipping.import_append: Keep them and add the imported rates
shipping.import_help: Columns: name, description, price, country, province, min_total, max_total. Prices and totals are plain amounts in your store currency. Country is a 2-letter code; province is the province code and may be empty.
shipping.import_mode: What to do with your current rates
shipping.import_rejected: That file is not a CSV file.
shipping.import_replace: Replace them with the imported rates
shipping.import_replace_nothing: Nothing was changed: in replace mode the file must be free of errors. Fix the rows below and import again.

shipping.name: Name

shipping.no_rate_message: The buyer sees "We don't deliver to this address yet." and cannot submit. You can change that text in Form designer, under Texts.
shipping.none_active: No rate is active, so buyers cannot complete the form. Turn on at least one rate.
shipping.order_help: Shown to buyers in this order. The first matching rate is preselected.
shipping.products_exclude: Not when the cart has one of these
shipping.products_only: Only when every item is one of these
